title: 第一卷第25章 这位壮士竟然是个女的第一卷第26章 见外了也生分了叫姐姐
content_zh:
“什么？”
顾寒有点没反应过来。
帮忙？
帮什么忙？
以你的修为，用得着我一个开脉境的修士帮忙？
“小兄弟，一定要帮我！”
那名年轻人又重复了一遍，语气中竟是带上了一丝哀求之色。
“一会有人问起，你可千万别说见过我啊！”
“千万千万不要说！我一生的幸福，就落在你手上了！”
刷！
话音落下，他带起一阵风，又是跑得没影了。
幸福？
顾寒依旧有些发懵。
什么幸福？
“少爷。”
阿傻悄悄探出小脑袋。
“他是谁啊？他不要咱们的灵药吗？”
“不管他！”
顾寒连忙将灵药收了起来。
“这人可能有病！”

“什么幸福不幸福的，跟我有什么关系！”
当然了。
吐槽归吐槽。
他也不敢再多停留了，万一那人再次去而复返，注意到了他手中的灵药，那就真的得不偿失了。
背起阿傻。
他特意挑了个与年轻人相反的方向，一路狂奔而去！
……
约莫一个时辰。
“呼……”
见身后始终没有人追来，顾寒轻轻吐了口气。
还好没追来！
先前与那根魔藤缠斗许久，已是消耗了他大半精力，此时又全力催动修为赶了如此长时间的路，便是灵力深厚如他，也觉得有些疲惫了。
“少爷。”
阿傻有些心疼，替他擦了擦汗。
“咱们还跑么？”
“不跑了。”
顾寒摇摇头。
“先找个地方休息一会，然后再……”
“吼！”
突然间！

一声咆哮陡然传来！
妖兽！
content_en:
"What?"
Gu Han didn't react.
help?
What help?
With your cultivation level, do you need the help of me, a monk in the Pulse Opening Realm?
"Little brother, you must help me!"
The young man repeated it again, with a hint of pleading in his tone.
"If someone asks you later, don't say you've seen me!"
"Never say it! The happiness of my life falls in your hands!"
Brush!
As soon as he finished speaking, he brought up a gust of wind and ran away again.
happiness?
Gu Han was still a little confused.
What happiness?
"Master."
Ah Sha quietly stuck out his little head.
"Who is he? Doesn't he want our elixir?"
"Ignore him!"
Gu Han quickly put away the elixir.
"This man may be sick!"
"What does happiness or unhappiness have to do with me?"
Of course.
Complaints are complaints.
He didn't dare to stay any longer. If that person came back again and noticed the elixir in his hand, it would really be more of a loss than a gain.
Carrying Asha on his back.
He deliberately chose the opposite direction to the young man and ran away!
…
About an hour.
"Huh..."
Seeing that no one was chasing after him, Gu Han let out a breath.
Fortunately, I didn’t come after him!
He had been fighting with the demonic vine for a long time, which had consumed most of his energy. Now he had to use all his strength to cultivate and drive for such a long time. Even with his spiritual power as deep as his, he felt a little tired.
"Master."
Ah Sha felt a little distressed and wiped his sweat for him.
"Are we still running?"
"No more running."
Gu Han shook his head.
"Find a place to rest for a while first, and then..."
"Roar!"
suddenly!
A roar suddenly came!
Monster!
